notes.title: Try Out Our Early Demo Until December 31st!
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays, everyone! 

We'll be full-speeding away in supporting the main game to ensure you all have the best experience, so the demo will only be around until [b]December 31st, 2024[/b]!

Give it a go while it's around!
